ResearchProjectDef.label: Sicarian killclades
ResearchProjectDef.description: Be vested with the authority and data to form, equip, and command the lethal cybernetic scouts and assassins of the Sicarian killclades.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Grievously wounded skitarii can still be of use to the Adeptus Mechanicus. A skilled surgeon and crafter can operate and convert anybody to a Sicarian - removing many higher brain functions and any capabilities besides violence, but minimising their capacity to feel pain and making them perfect candidates for extreme martially-focused augmetics.\n\nOnly those who have undergone this conversion can make use of Sicarian equipment.
